en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The chuckling (laughing) does not break the ablution, and (but) it breaks the Salāt’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Laughing does not invalidate Wudu’ but it invalidates Salah (prayer).”’
